purpose: Version 2 English-accent listening audition. Reuses the exact 20 approved race/gender timbre WAVs, fixed text, matched seeds, neutral delivery and CFG 4. Strengthens non-base accent cues while keeping race-linked timbre fixed.
contentNotice: Exploratory fictional character voice directions, not canon or production geography policy. Breton Southern English remains the comparison baseline. All other accent cues are clearer in v2. Bosmer remains calm and less quirky; Orc stays naturally throaty without inserted grunt noises; Khajiit female Arabic-influenced English cue is deliberately clearer while male Khajiit wording stays close to accepted v1. Argonian rough guttural direction stays as accepted in v1. Each sample keeps its original gender/timbre reference, fixed text, seed, emotion and CFG 4. No audio is generated by preparing this corpus.
fixedText: Good day, traveller. The road ahead is long, but you are welcome to rest here for a while.

trialControls.seedPolicy: Reuse the exact seed from the matching original race/gender sample; no rerolls.
trialControls.speakerReferencePolicy: Use the corresponding successful WAV from race-voices-01 plus its exact transcript as fixed speaker reference.
trialControls.timbrePolicy: Keep each original race/gender speaker reference and timbre direction fixed. Strengthen non-base pronunciation and cadence cues only, except requested natural Orc throat texture and clearer Khajiit female Arabic-influenced English; preserve the accepted Khajiit male and Argonian directions.
trialControls.isolationGoal: Audition English accent differences while holding reference speaker, text, seed, emotion, delivery and CFG fixed.
